description:
## Why This Exists

post/injection.rs uses format!() with String arguments to build new header lines, which allocates a String on every call. The inner helper functions (strip_all_occurrences, find_header_end, find_line_end, skip_line_terminator) work directly on bytes, which is correct. But prepend_path_header, inject_message_id, inject_injection_info, inject_injection_date all build the new line via format!() into a String and then extend_from_slice the bytes. The construction is correct but verbose.

## Acceptance Criteria

No functional change needed; this is a style note. Consider using write!() to a pre-allocated Vec<u8> or bytes::BytesMut to avoid intermediate String allocation.
title: Rust idiom: many Vec<u8> round-trips via String::from_utf8_lossy in injection.rs
